applicationName.description: Empty = derive from the destination (clusterbook-operator-<sha1[:8]>), so two clusters cannot collide in the management cluster's argocd namespace.

destination.description: The cluster that runs Argo CD — the operator writes Argo CD cluster Secrets into the cluster it runs on. Provide `server` or `name`; if both are set, `name` wins. `namespace` is the operator namespace (kustomize namespace).

tag.description: Image tag patched over the base's manager container. Keep in step with `version`.

trustBundle.description: trust-manager CA bundle mount (optional ConfigMap) + SSL_CERT_DIR on the manager container.

protectCRDs.description: Annotate the CRDs Prune=false,Delete=false: deleting them deletes every ClusterbookCluster and, through its finalizer, deregisters the cluster.

cascadingDelete.description: Put a resources-finalizer on the child Application. False by default: an opt-out should stop managing the operator, not uninstall it (argocd#324).
